items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: Xavier Cugat and Duke Ellington, yeah you can tell the difference in orchestras

ctx.x: To me there is no difference in sound. There is like a Latin band versus a swing band — Xavier Cugat and Duke Ellington, yeah you can tell the difference in orchestras, but not individual musicianship see, what jazz is.
In all the playing you’ve done, did you ever have any physical problems that kind of put a crimp in your activities for a while?
